name: dkj-claude-plugins
description: The Claude Specialists system by Dave (DaveKJohn): a team of specialized Claudes under one Chief of Staff. Every plugin here is either a TEAM — who the specialists are — or a WORKFLOW — how work moves through the repo they land in. Teams stack: enable the core team plus whichever add-on teams fit the repo. Workflows mostly do not — two that answered the same question differently would collide — so there is one general workflow, plus dkj-policy-bwj, a deliberately narrow additive layer extending the ticket-work step, what a sync branch owes, and how a preview is handed to a reviewer. One product, one repository, one marketplace.

plugins.name: dkj-subagents-alpha
plugins.description: The core team — the shared, repo-neutral specialists who work the same way in every repo. Every consuming repo enables this. Governance (CLAUDE.md + the repo lenses) stays at repo level.

plugins.name: dkj-subagents-lifehub
plugins.description: Add-on team for life-hub-style repos (a personal information hub / brain-based knowledge repo): Astrid, Fiona, Hugo, Ian, Onyx. Only a life-hub-style repo enables this.

plugins.name: dkj-subagents-shopify
plugins.description: Add-on team for Shopify store repos (e.g. smartwatchbanden): Liam, Sandra, Steven, plus the domain skill start-task. Only a Shopify repo enables this.

plugins.name: dkj-subagents-ecomm
plugins.description: Add-on team for commercial webshop repos (any platform): Sergio (SEO), Craig (CRO), Sean (performance/SEA), with room to grow into the wider e-commerce craft (lifecycle/email, analytics). Complementary to a platform team like dkj-subagents-shopify — a commercial webshop repo can enable both. Teams stack.

plugins.name: dkj-policy
plugins.description: DaveKJohn's own way of working, packaged as an opt-in: the branch-and-entry model, the tier ladder, the fold, the release cut, and the gates that hold them, as skills plus their shared scripts. A workflow is not a team but a method, and the name says whose it is: DKJ's policy, the top rung of the order, not a baseline every consumer inherits. Enable this only if you want THIS one. Requires dkj-subagents-alpha.

plugins.name: dkj-policy-bwj
plugins.description: BWJ's codex — the binding rules the working environment of BWJ's two Shopify store repos (smartwatchbanden and xoxowildhearts) operates under, so both run one identical procedure and cannot drift. An ADDITIVE add-on to dkj-policy — it extends the ticket-work layer before a branch, what a sync branch owes, and how a preview is handed to a reviewer; it contradicts nothing that workflow decides. Four chapters. TICKET HANDLING: a discovered issue is filed on GitHub first, then mirrored to Asana as a colleague-friendly variant, cross-linked both ways; closing the GitHub issue makes a CI workflow the plugin ships as a template post an update saying the work is ready to test and move the card — it never ticks the task off. THE SYNC LOG: a sync branch mirrors what a third party changed on the live theme and is exempt from the changelog by design, so it owes a sync-log entry instead — dkj-policy-bwj/SYNC-LOG.md, newest first, written and committed by dkj-subagents-shopify's sync-main.ps1 in the same breath as the branch, never folded and never released. THE PREVIEW HANDOVER: where a preview is owed, it is a PAIR per market — the preview beside the live control, whose URL pins the live theme id, because preview_theme_id sets a cookie and the bare URL then keeps serving the preview while the reviewer believes they are on live. That pair travels as ONE link to a published page carrying a QR code per market, plus what the gates already proved and the one question being asked — never as a table of URLs, which a terminal wraps past selecting, a phone cannot scan, and which carries no state. THE THEME LIFECYCLE: the estate owes two things at the two moments it grows - after the live push, the spent preview themes THIS repo created are swept away; at the release cut that closes that push, a fresh backup of live is taken, polled until it is provably complete (the CLI returns long before the copy is), and only then is the previous backup rotated out, so exactly one is retained and there is never a window with none. Every delete is bounded by a reserved name prefix this repo wrote, never by a theme's role: a store carries far more themes belonging to agencies, apps and colleagues than to the repo, and a role-keyed sweep would destroy them all while looking correct. It relaxes nothing about which changes owe a preview, or about no PR opening before one is approved. Carries no specialists. Requires dkj-subagents-alpha and dkj-policy; the sync and preview chapters also expect dkj-subagents-shopify. Enable this in BWJ's two store repos for all four chapters, or in this plugin's own source repo for ticket handling alone (admitted September 14, 2026, commit b9b2a65a) -- the other three chapters are Shopify-store policy and stay at the two stores.
